title: Birth save no longer requires body-metrics consent
summary: Saving birth date derives age server-side; that derived age was incorrectly treated as a body-metrics field touch, so PATCH /users/me demanded bodyMetricsConsent and returned CONSENT_REQUIRED. Age is excluded from body-metrics touch detection. Select-all toggle restored.
testFocus: Settings > birth profile: check birth consents only (no body metrics section) > Save succeeds
Select-all toggles on and off again as before
Body metrics save still requires body consent when height/weight/etc change
productionChecks: Hard refresh Settings birth section → consent → Save

deploy.expected: Render backend required; Pages optional for select-all revert

asIs: Birth save failed with server consent toast after all birth checks
toBe: Birth save succeeds with only birthProfileConsent; derived age does not demand body consent
